summary: Grande Group Ltd (NASDAQ: GRAN), a BVI-incorporated Hong Kong-based finance services issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing notice of an Extraordinary General Meeting (the non-US equivalent of a special shareholder meeting) along with separate Class A and Class B meetings, proxy forms, and a proposed Fourth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles. The EGM is set for October 21, 2026, 10:00AM U.S. Eastern, virtual-only. Proposal 1 would vary Class B rights, raising voting power from 20 to 100 votes per share while stripping dividend and liquidation participation; Proposal 2 adopts the new articles. The board recommends FOR. No deal terms, stake, or price are stated. Watch the dual-class control concentration and any governance or index-eligibility fallout.
